services.name: Private Sessions
services.desc: Any RESOBOX class can be booked as your own private session - a Japanese artist, one table, and something made by hand. For the days that deserve more than the usual. Private sessions are tailored to the occasion: the same craft can be playful for a birthday, contemplative for a small gathering, or structured for a school group. Every class carries something beyond the fun of it - patience from kumiko joinery, seasonality from wagashi, presence from tea - so the hour can lean lighthearted or genuinely educational, whichever your day calls for. And everyone leaves with something they actually made. All ages are welcome - our teachers adapt each craft so children join comfortably alongside

services.name: Craft workshop
services.desc: Kumiko is the traditional Japanese art of assembling delicate wooden lattices without nails or glue. Each piece is cut so precisely that the pattern holds together through fit alone - a technique refined over centuries, still gracing shoji screens and fine interiors across Japan.In this hands-on class you will:1. Discover what kumiko is - its history and how it works2. Practice all three foundation patterns: asa-no-ha (hemp leaf), rindō (gentian), and goma (sesame) - building each one in the same practice frame, then taking it apart to try the next3. Use what you have learned to design your own arrangement inside the ichirin-zashi flower vaseAll kits are handcrafted by Ōminato Bunkichi
